title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Maya Chen
body: Motivation: automate TLS certificate rotation and KMS/HSM integration for Private deployments to reduce operational burden and eliminate manual cert rollouts during upgrades. This PR introduces a cert-rotation operator and Terraform/Helm automation to provision, rotate, and verify TLS keys and certificates using customer-managed KMS keys or HSM-backed keys, and integrates with Vault and sealed-secrets for GitOps workflows. High level changes: 1) add a new Helm chart component `cert-rotator` (operator + controller + optional cron-job) that can request, renew, and atomically swap TLS secrets for the control plane and ingress components; supports ACME (optional), Vault PKI, and direct CSR signing via KMS/HSM through a PKCS#11 shim. 2) add Terraform module updates to create and manage KMS key resources (AWS KMS key alias, IAM policies, GCP KMS) and HSM config stubs for on-prem HSM vendors; modules emit rotation metadata used by the operator. 3) sealed-secrets/K8s secret lifecycle: a migration helper is added to re-encrypt existing sealed secrets with the new KMS/HSM-wrapped master key to ensure seamless GitOps after key rotation. 4) Vault integration: operator can optionally fetch intermediate CA certs from Vault PKI and perform automated renewals with token role bindings. 5) private-installer changes: install/upgrade plan includes step-by-step non-disruptive rollout, preflight checks, and a rollback tool for immediate key revert in case of failure. Implementation details: - cert-rotator operator (Go) with a small controller loop that watches CertificateRotation CRD, validates target workloads, performs blue/green secret swaps, and posts webhook readiness checks to kube-ingress and control-plane health endpoints. - PKCS#11 shim abstraction to call HSM-bound signing operations; a lightweight shim binary is included under installer/bin and documented in the private-installer README. - Terraform: new module terraform/modules/kms that outputs key metadata (key_id, key_version, rotation_schedule) and IAM principals; callers can opt into HSM mode via variable enable_hsm=true. - Helm: templates added to charts/private-installer to deploy cert-rotator, CRDs, RBAC, ServiceAccount with KMS permissions and sealed-secrets controller patch for rekeying. - Migration tooling: installer/scripts/rekey-sealed-secrets.sh performs a dry-run and then re-encrypts repository manifests using `kubeseal --reencrypt` with the new public key; an option to use Vault transit for re-encryption is provided. Rollout plan and safety: - Default install is opt-in; operator disabled unless values.certRotator.enabled=true. - Automated canary: cert-rotator supports canary=true to rotate a single ingress/control-plane instance and run traffic checks before cluster-wide swap. - Health hooks and readiness gates prevent secret swap if endpoints fail probes. - Rollback: installer/upgrade/rollback.sh can revert to previous sealed-secret encryption keys and reapply old TLS secrets. Testing and validation: - Unit tests for operator logic, and integration tests in perf-canary that simulate key rotation and HSM failures. - CI pipeline adds E2E job that runs against a Kind cluster with a mocked HSM and Vault instance. - Manual runbook included under docs/private-installer/tls-rotation.md. Backwards compatibility and notes: - No breaking API changes; default behavior unchanged unless enabled. - For clusters with older sealed-secrets versions, migration script will detect incompatible formats and fail fast with detailed instructions. - HSM support requires provider-specific config; we include examples for SoftHSM and a vendor HSM shim. Security considerations: - KMS keys and HSM access granted via least-privilege IAM policies created by Terraform module. - Operator stores only minimal rotation metadata in cluster; private keys remain wrapped/encrypted via sealed-secrets or Vault. - Audit logging and rotation events are emitted to the console and to optional webhook sinks. Deployment notes: - See docs/private-installer/tls-rotation.md for step-by-step upgrade and rollback. - Customers using private HSMs must set values.hsm.enabled and provide PKCS11 config through installer secrets. - When using Vault PKI, ensure Vault role and token TTL are configured per instructions. This PR includes tests, docs, and migration helpers to make rollout low-risk and reversible.
commits: feat: add cert-rotator operator and CertificateRotation CRD
feat(terraform): add kms module with hsm toggle and IAM bindings
chore(helm): add cert-rotator templates, RBAC, and values schema
feat: migration script for re-encrypting sealed-secrets with new KMS key
fix: avoid transient downtime by blue/green secret swap logic
docs: add tls-rotation runbook and upgrade notes
test: add integration test for rotation with mocked HSM and Vault
review_comments: Omar Syed: Can we add a dry-run mode to the migration script? - addressed, added --dry-run flag and tests.
Priya Natarajan: Ensure RBAC is least-privilege and documented. - updated chart and added sample IAM policies in terraform module.
Diego Morales: What happens if HSM becomes unreachable mid-rotation? - added fallback to previous key and improved health probes to prevent swap.
Maya Chen (author): replied to reviewers with test results from perf-canary and a step-by-step rollback demo log.
CI bot: E2E rotation test failed on first run (mocked HSM timeout) — reran after increasing shim timeout; tests passed on second run.
release_notes: Adds optional cert-rotator operator, Terraform KMS/HSM module, Helm chart updates, and migration helpers to automate TLS and sealed-secrets rekeying for Private installer; opt-in via values.certRotator.enabled; includes rollback tooling and runbook.
notes_on_migration: Run installer/scripts/rekey-sealed-secrets.sh --dry-run first; ensure you have backups of previous sealed secrets and a tested rollback window; for Vault users, validate PKI roles and TTLs before enabling operator.
